annotations.title: Ready-made ad rules (Meta and Google Ads)

description: Ready-made automated ad rules to start from: stop losers, scale winners, pause spend with no conversions, creative fatigue alert, spend spike alert, trim expensive clicks. Each is a complete body for create_meta_ad_rule or create_google_ads_rule: add the ad account, adjust the thresholds it names, send it (rules are created switched off). Filter by platform (meta or google_ads) or id. Nothing is created. Free.
